answer: Streak multipliers: each epoch mined increments rep r → payout ×(1+0.1r). A sybil splitting into n wallets resets each to r=0, forfeiting the multiplier — at r=50 that's 6× revenue lost per clone. The zephyr of fresh wallets never accumulates continuity. Cross-referencing streaks on the tundra of historical epochs, each wallet must hold stake ≥100 POA unbroken or the ledge collapses to baseline. Cost to fake 10 aged streaks: 10×100 POA locked 50 epochs vs. 1 wallet earning 6×. Negative EV.
